reviews.title: Excellent original replacement filter.
reviews.body: Slow to deliver since this comes from outside UAE, but works as expected. Seems to be original. Of course i am not doing a scientific test of the water pre and post filter, but it does seem to filter out smells and tastes (for some weeks before this came, we ran out brita jug without any filter, and it was picking up smells like onion, etc from the air in the fridge, and after  we installed the new one, the water 100% has no foriegn smell/taste anymore)
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Arab Emirates on 16 November 2020

reviews.title: worth it
reviews.body: These are worth it to filter more contaminates, use less plastic, and spend less compared to cost of two-month Brita brand. They fit in different Brita pitchers, but may need a firm push to make sure it is sealed and water is not bypassing the filter. It is normal for the filter to get more saturated every month and water flow will slow down. In month five I noticed if the filter processed extra gallons, the flow may get very slow and the water gets a taste -then I replace it. But this is rare since I am the one person is using it. If the pitcher is refilled more than two times a day or an extra large dispenser is used, one may need to change the filter more often.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 26 June 2026
reviews.author: PRF

features: LONG LASTING: The Longlast Filter has a 3X longer life compared to 40 gallon filters, including our Standard Brita Filter - change the filters every 120 gallons or about every 6 months.

BPA FREE AND EASY INSTALLATION: The Longlast Filter is BPA free and compatible with all Brita Pitchers except Stream and Infinity. Filter has a pull top cap which makes it quick and easy to change and there is no presoak or rinse required!

CLEANER: Only Brita filters are certified to reduce contaminants in Brita Pitchers. Longlast filters are certified by WQA to reduce 99% of lead as well as reduce cadmium, mercury, and asbestos. Contaminants reduced may not be in all users' water.
GREAT TASTING: Brita filters reduce chlorine taste and odor found in tap water. Substances reduced may not be found in all users' water.
REDUCE WASTE: One Longlast Filter can replace 900 standard 16.9 ounce water bottles, keep you hydrated, save you money, and reduce plastic waste.
